purpose: Teach: 同性愛/囚人/開戦/捕虜/硬化/反逆/窮地/救援

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、同性愛の社会的受容の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you took up research on the social acceptance of homosexuality in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm teacher's cadence, deliberate pace; gentle confirming lift on the tag, inviting her to elaborate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、囚人の更生プログラムの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — and I covered research on rehabilitation programs for prisoners, too.
lines.style: Quick bright 'yes', then careful recitation; eager to show the work was done properly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 開戦に至るまでの外交史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also covered the diplomatic history leading up to the outbreak of war.
lines.style: Slower, more thoughtful delivery; weighing the topic's seriousness, voice dipping softly at the close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、捕虜の処遇の国際法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about international law on the treatment of prisoners of war.
lines.style: Steady and composed now, pride settling into confidence; clean articulation of the legal phrasing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 動脈硬化、つまり硬化症の医学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Arteriosclerosis — hardening of the arteries — you handled that medical research as well, didn't you?
lines.style: Careful teacherly clarification mid-line, slight slow-down on the term, then a warm approving tag.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、歴史上の反逆罪の刑法的研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered criminal-law studies of historical treason cases.
lines.style: Crisp, focused answer; a touch faster, enjoying the momentum of listing her own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 被災者の窮地からの脱出の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered sociological research on how disaster victims escape dire situations, didn't you?
lines.style: Softening tone, genuine warmth surfacing; slower pace as the review winds toward its end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、災害救援活動の実証研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I finished with empirical research on disaster relief operations.
lines.style: Quiet satisfied finality; small exhale before answering, ending on a settled, contented note.
